Budlum Validator Duties Unavailable
Validator duties are not connected yet. Audits are not running. Reopen the app to view its status.

This build does not store or audit network content. Future validators may store erasure-coded shares, and sealed content must remain end-to-end encrypted. Faucet requests may perform bounded anti-bot proof of work, not block mining.

Owner spend, staking, rotation and unbonding are unavailable. No wallet signer or Keystore-backed biometric/PIN authorization is connected. Operator and BLS key wrapping alone does not make validator duties operational.
Submit faucet request (100 BUD)
Validator registration, signing and custody are not connected to the chain in this build. A faucet request does not create a local balance or stake.

Enter the HTTPS origin of your testnet faucet and the 0x-prefixed 32-byte address of a wallet you control. This app cannot create or verify a wallet yet. Never enter your seed phrase. A submitted transfer is not a confirmed balance. The faucet may limit requests by address and IP.
